snippet.title: Snoot Game: Last Second Save and Matters of Trust reveal trailer.
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD HERE: https://snootgame.xyz/

Anon gets his act together and stops himself at the very brink of Ending 1. Now that he's at the edge of the abyss, he has to make his way back up. Alas, he can't undo the damage that's already been done, but that doesn't mean he won't try.

The story remains linear all throughout, with only the final chapters offering seven impactful decisions. There is only one ending, decided by picking "Help her" at the start of the game.

Duration: roughly 10+ hours

Cool features:
character development for Ripley, Samantha, Naomi, Naser, Trish and Reed
12 bonus stories
Streamer Mode - play the game safely on Youtube or Twitch with replaced music!
190+ hand-drawn artworks
230+ custom sprites (check them out on Snootbooru!)
38 main menu screens that change depending on recently played chapter/bonus story
full-blown gallery with all custom artworks, new sprites etc.

This game is very much a love letter to Snoot Game and I (the author) hope that sentiment shines through in the sheer attention to detail and care put into the story and art. I hope you enjoy!

Matters of Trust:

The game is currently in development.

The story takes place a year after prom night, with Anon stuck in the Navy and Fang attempting to continue her music career. With him out of the picture, the role of the main protagonist goes to Reed, who'll be trying to help Fang after their botched, unexpected "reunion". Along the way, he comes across Fang's family, some old friends and a couple new faces, all trying to aid Fang one way or another.
﻿
Unlike in Last Second Save, this does not have a happy ending. Anon already made his choice and there's no turning back. The story contains only a few cosmetic choices that don't affect the plot.

Cool features:
character development for Reed, Rosa, Naser, Naomi, Samantha and Ripley
bonus stories!
Streamer Mode - play the game safely on Youtube or Twitch with replaced music!
LJ is a prominent side character
250+ hand drawn character sprites
50+ hand-drawn CGs
